The expense ratio is the thing I keep coming back to as we get closer to a decision point on Sequim, because 21% on a newly built park feels low enough that I want to see the actual line items before we go much further. Industry benchmarks for RV and MH parks typically run 35-45% once you factor in management, insurance, taxes, maintenance, and any capex reserve, and $40k against $190k gross doesn't leave room for all of those unless something is being left out or self-managed in a way that won't carry over to us.
